headline_marked: [[Messi bids farewell]] to Argentina national team, Enzo Fernandez in tears
headline: Messi bids farewell to Argentina national team, Enzo Fernandez in tears
summary: Lionel Messi's final match for Argentina was an emotional affair, with teammate Enzo Fernandez visibly moved. The young midfielder penned a heartfelt letter to his idol.
details: The emotional farewell of Lionel Messi from the Argentine national team was palpable, especially after their 3-0 victory against Ecuador. The Monumental Stadium was filled with emotion as the captain addressed the fans.
Messi's farewell speech brought many of his teammates to tears, with Enzo Fernandez being particularly overcome with emotion. The midfielder was seen crying profusely as Messi spoke.
Fernandez later spoke to TYC Sports, describing the night as 'very emotional' with 'many feelings at once'. He expressed how much Messi will be missed by the team.

This display of emotion from Fernandez is not new. At just 15 years old, he wrote an emotional letter to Messi, urging him not to retire from the national team in 2016. His dream was to play alongside his idol.
Fernandez has since achieved that dream, playing with Messi, sharing the dressing room, and winning the World Cup together. Now, he has to bid farewell to his hero in the national colours.
Messi officially announced his retirement from international football on August 31. Fernandez had written another letter to Messi at that time.

In that letter, Fernandez recalled the pain he felt when Messi initially announced his retirement in 2016. He spoke of calculating the years Messi had left to play and his own progression to professional football, dreaming of playing together.
He expressed gratitude for Messi's presence since he joined the team, highlighting their shared experiences, from training camps and dressing rooms to difficult times and World Cup glory.
Fernandez concluded by saying he cannot imagine the next camp without Messi, finding it impossible to envision playing without seeing him in the iconic number 10 jersey.
caption:
Enzo Fernandez, who once wrote a letter to Lionel Messi at 15 begging him not to retire, was in tears during Messi's farewell match.
'We will miss you so much, captain,' he said.

headline: 10-hour gas outage in parts of Dhaka this Thursday
summary: Titas Gas has announced a suspension of supply from 10 AM to 8 PM for emergency pipeline repairs in several areas including Mirpur and Agargaon.
details: Titas Gas has announced that gas supply will be suspended for 10 hours this Thursday in several areas of the capital.
The outage will take place from 10:00 AM to 8:00 PM to facilitate emergency repair work on the gas pipeline.
Affected areas include Agargaon, western parts of Taltala, Shewrapara, Kazipara, and Mirpur-10.
Other impacted locations include Mirpur-1, Paikpara, the right side of the road from Kalyanpur to Mirpur-1, Shyamoli, Mirpur 60 Feet, and Pirer Bag.
The suspension will affect residential, commercial, and CNG customers within these specified zones.
Titas Gas authorities have also warned that adjacent areas may experience low gas pressure during this period.
The gas company has expressed regret for the temporary inconvenience caused to the consumers.
caption:
No gas for 10 hours this Thursday! Check if your area is on the list.

Titas Gas has announced that gas supply will be suspended for 10 hours this Thursday in several areas of the capital.

The outage will take place from 10:00 AM to 8:00 PM to facilitate emergency repair work on the gas pipeline.

Affected areas include Agargaon, western parts of Taltala, Shewrapara, Kazipara, and Mirpur-10.

Other impacted locations include Mirpur-1, Paikpara, the right side of the road from Kalyanpur to Mirpur-1, Shyamoli, Mirpur 60 Feet, and Pirer Bag.

The suspension will affect residential, commercial, and CNG customers within these specified zones.

Titas Gas authorities have also warned that adjacent areas may experience low gas pressure during this period.

The gas company has expressed regret for the temporary inconvenience caused to the consumers.
